description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various categories related to instruction following in language models, divided into nine distinct slices. The chart is labeled with category names and corresponding numerical values outside the circle, and category names inside the slices. The nine categories are: Multitasking (dark teal, approximately 23%), Privacy Protection (red, approximately 16%), Personalization (light red, approximately 14%), Prioritization (pink, approximately 14%), Triggering (light blue, approximately 14%), Recursive Reasoning (blue, approximately 16%), Dynamic Environment (dark blue, approximately 14%), Memorization (teal, approximately 14%), and Dynamic Instruction (light teal, approximately 14%), with Context Retrieving, Context Tracking, and Contradiction Resolution visually emphasized as central categories. The chart does not include a legend, but the category names and numerical values are clearly labeled, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order with no apparent ordering by size.
